new_candidates.notes: [VERIFY] Final scope, effective date, treatment of pending projects, and duration remain unverified; the only county documents located as of 2026-07-31 are the hearing notice and an unsigned draft order. enacted_status=pending and duration_kind=until_event reflect that a signed final order was not located. Hays County's June 23 Emergency Water Protection Review Period was excluded from this pass: it explicitly does not halt statutory permit processing or impose a data center ban, only deferring discretionary tax-abatement, development-agreement, and variance approvals for high-water-use projects, matching the subsidy/tax-incentive-freeze exclusion rule rather than a Chapter 212 Subchapter E development moratorium.
